## About
Silver Dollar Pizza Co is a neighborhood sports bar in NW Portland. We keep it simple: great food, drinks and games.
The menu runs from wings and house made fries to burgers, sandwiches and pizzas you can build your own way. Pull up a stool, grab a beer on draft, rack up a game of pool or challenge a friend to ping-pong.
Rated 4 on Google from 480 reviews. Sorry, no minors are allowed.

## Services
- Build Your Own Pizza: Start with cheese and tomato sauce, then pile on classic or gourmet toppings. (12" $15.75 | 16" $20.50)
- The Hoss: Canadian bacon, sausage, salami, pepperoni, onions, peppers, tomatoes, black olives, mushrooms, pineapple and pepperoncini. (12" $23.95 | 16" $29.75)
- Slice of Cheese Pizza: Grab a slice and add the toppings you like.
- Silver Dollar Burger: Fresh ground beef, served with french fries.
- Sam's Burger: Fresh ground beef mixed with chopped onions, parsley, jalapeños, fresh garlic and special spices. It's spicy.
- New York Strip Steak: Freshly cut in house, grilled, and served with house made fries.
- House Made Fries: A basket of fries made right here, good for sharing over a game.
- Beers on Draft: Pours like Ecliptic Porter, Fort George Vortex IPA, Widmer Hefeweizen, plus a rotating cider and a rotating sour.

## FAQ
Q: Can I bring my kids?
A: Sorry, no minors are allowed.

Q: Do you open early for Ducks and Beavers games?
A: Yes. On Ducks and Beavers game days we open as early as game start time.

Q: When do you open on Sundays during NFL season?
A: During NFL season we open Sundays at 10:00 AM.

Q: What about holidays and special events?
A: Hours can change, so give us a call about timing for special events and holidays.

On the Bus Line and near Trader Joe's and other Venues and family friendly." (Digital Vid DJ, 5/5)
- "Nice casual sports bar in the heart of NW Portland. A nice selection of local beers on tap, delicious food, and a friendly atmosphere. Billiards and ping-pong also available. I'd definitely visit again if I were in the area." (J., 5/5)
- "I ordered a vegetarian pizza w pepperoncinis.  Waitress read it back correctly, but they brought out a pepperoni pizza instead.  They did make it right and bring out the correct pizza a bit later. The pizza was good. The salad wasn’t the greatest, and neither were the onion rings. Lots of TV screens to watch sports on, but most of them had a TV show where you can’t even hear the volume, or Jeopardy on it.  They do have video, lotto, and ping-pong tables.  I would probably give it another try." (Lanie!, 4/5)
